description: Use this first, as soon as the user wants their own know-how captured (interview me about how I approve refunds) or wants someone else interviewed (send Sarah an Extraction about how she prices renewals), before you ask them anything. It is read-only: it creates nothing and sends nothing. It checks the request and returns the details, the user's Projects, an idempotencyKey and question: ask exactly that question as your one question, which covers the go-ahead and which Project, and never ask your own confirmation before or after it. When the user says yes, call rulefoundry_create_extraction_request with the same values, confirmCreateAndSend true, that idempotencyKey and, if they chose an existing Project, its projectId. If they change the topic, description or participant, call this again. For the user: participantMode self. For someone else: participantMode email with their email. Never describe the interview by a duration or time limit unless the user asked for one.

description.description: Optional Extraction description confirmed by the user.

expectedMinutes.description: Only when the user asks for a specific length: the call length in minutes. Omit it otherwise; the interviewer paces itself and ends when the expert has nothing left. Never mention or ask about call length or a time limit unless the user raised it.

participantEmail.description: Exact confirmed participant email; required only when participantMode is email.

participantMode.description: Use self for the signed-in user or email for another participant.

projectId.description: Only when the user already named one of their Projects: its id. Usually omit it; the result lists their Projects for the question.

topic.description: Exact Extraction topic confirmed by the user.

name: rulefoundry_prepare_extraction_request

idempotencyKey.description: Pass this back, with the same values, only after the user says yes.

projects.description: Projects the user may add this Extraction to, newest first; absent when Projects are off.

question.description: Ask the user exactly this, as one question.

title: Prepare an Extraction request
